claim.quote: Using the KEDR detector at the VEPP-4M $e^+e^-$ collider, we have determined the values of $R$ at thirteen points of the center-of-mass energy between 1.84 and 3.05 GeV.

date.locator: arXiv abstract page, submission date (arXiv:1610.02827 v1, 10 October 2016)
date.note: Published in Phys. Lett. B (2017), DOI 10.1016/j.physletb.2017.04.073 per the arXiv page.

key_value_text.quote: The achieved accuracy is about or better than $3.9\%$ at most of the energy points with a systematic uncertainty less than $2.4\%$.
key_value_text.value: Accuracy about or better than 3.9% at most energy points; systematic uncertainty below 2.4%

name: Measurement of R between 1.84 and 3.05 GeV at the KEDR detector

summary.plain: KEDR measured R, the ratio of hadron production to muon-pair production in electron-positron collisions, at thirteen energies between 1.84 and 3.05 GeV, with an accuracy of about 3.9% or better at most points.
summary.technical: KEDR at VEPP-4M: R at thirteen centre-of-mass energies between 1.84 and 3.05 GeV, accuracy about or better than 3.9% at most points with systematic uncertainty below 2.4%.

title: Measurement of R between 1.84 and 3.05 GeV at the KEDR detector
why_it_matters: The abstract states the achieved accuracy and the systematic uncertainty of the R values.
